name: Onternabez
summary: Onternabez (also known as HU-308, HU308, PPP-003, and ARDS-003) is a synthetic cannabinoid that acts as a potent cannabinoid agonist. It is highly selective for the cannabinoid-2 receptor (CB2 receptor) subtype, with a selectivity more than 5,000 times greater for the CB2 receptor than the CB1 receptor.

pharmacology.text: Onternabez (also known as HU-308, HU308, PPP-003, and ARDS-003) is a synthetic cannabinoid that acts as a potent cannabinoid agonist. It is highly selective for the cannabinoid-2 receptor (CB2 receptor) subtype, with a selectivity more than 5,000 times greater for the CB2 receptor than the CB1 receptor.

summaryZh: 昂特納貝，分子式C27H42O3，是一種人工合成的HU系列大麻素，由耶路撒冷希伯來大學的拉斐爾·梅舒朗團隊在1990年代晚期開發。

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for inflammation and lung injury. Because it acts on CB2 rather than CB1, it is not expected to cause a cannabis-like high.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於發炎與肺損傷的研究。由於它作用於 CB2 而非 CB1，一般預期不會產生類似大麻的快感。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于发炎与肺损伤的研究。由于它作用于 CB2 而非 CB1，一般预期不会产生类似大麻的快感。

fact.en: Its older name HU-308 marks it as one of the Hebrew University compounds made in the laboratory of Raphael Mechoulam, the chemist who first worked out the structure of THC.
fact.zh: 它的舊名 HU-308 表示它是希伯來大學的化合物之一，出自首次解出 THC 結構的化學家拉斐爾．梅舒朗的實驗室。
fact.zhHans: 它的旧名 HU-308 表示它是希伯来大学的化合物之一，出自首次解出 THC 结构的化学家拉斐尔．梅舒朗的实验室。
